description.zh:
RAM 用户的登录名称。 

如果为空，默认获取当前用户的指定访问密钥的网络访问限制策略。
description.en:
The logon name of the RAM user. 

If this parameter is left empty, the network access restriction policy of the specified access key for the current user is returned by default.

title.zh: 查询指定访问密钥的网络访问限制策略
title.en: Query the network access restriction policy of a specified access key

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims get-access-key-policy --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
